title: Contract
description: All circuit-core wire types. Generated by circuit-core; do not edit.

hints.description: Kept sorted and de-duplicated so the order never depends on edit history.

params.description: Every param declared by the registry part, keyed by name ("resistance" -> 10kΩ).

Quantity.description: A parsed physical value. `display` is canonical and round-trips exactly through [`parse_quantity`].

PinRef.description: Part pin as REFDES.PIN, e.g. "R3.1" or "U1.OUT_A".

BlockPort.description: A named interface of a block, bound to the net that carries it (checked by ERC009).

OpEnvelope.description: One op in its envelope (LLD §4): `{v, seq, op, author, job?, block?, base_rev, body}`.

oneOf.description: Inverse of `block.begin`.
Inverse of `block.commit` / `block.abort`.
Inverse of `hint.add`.

params.description: Values as written ("10k", "4.7u"); unspecified params take the registry default.

origin.description: Normally derived from the envelope; set explicitly by inverse ops so undo restores it.

kind.description: Applied when the net is created; must match if the net exists.

op_index.description: Index of the failing op within a batch (`apply_all`).

oneOf.description: Envelope or body does not match the schema.
Envelope `v` is not the current or previous protocol version.
Circuit and registry versions differ.
Refdes is malformed or its prefix does not match the part category.
A value string could not be parsed in the param's unit.
Swap target is in a different category.
Malformed net id, ground misuse, or a kind/label that disagrees with the existing net.
Net id already exists (case-insensitive, since SPICE node names are).
Block still has parts or hints referring to it.
Analysis parameters are invalid.
The author is not allowed to emit this op (e.g. `part.pin` is user-only).
No block template with this id in the registry.
A template target or rail voltage is malformed or outside the template's range.
A port binding names a net that cannot carry that port (wrong kind, missing, ground misuse).

ErrorCode.description:
Error codes returned by `apply()`. These go back to the LLM verbatim during repair and are
shown to users as friendly text (LLD §4). Additive only within a protocol major version.

Patch.description: What changed, by id, so the UI never needs the whole circuit per op (LLD §10).

inverse.description: Ops that undo this change, in the order they must be applied.

ApplyOk.description: What a successful `apply` reports to the UI: only what changed (LLD §10).

PatchData.description:
The current state of everything a [`Patch`] names, so a UI mirror can update itself without
reading the whole circuit (LLD §10). Removed ids are in the patch itself.

errors.description:
Every rejected op, with `op_index` set. Rejected ops are skipped; the rest still apply,
so the LLM gets all its mistakes back in one repair round.

inverse.description: Undo for the ops that did apply.

Trial.description: Outcome of a trial batch (the orchestrator's composer draft).

ErcContext.description: Who the check is for: LLM blocks must be clean; learners may build broken circuits.

oneOf.description: Rejects an LLM block; for user edits, blocks simulation.

shunt_floating.description:
Add a 1 GΩ shunt to ground on every node without a DC path (user circuits, ERC003),
so the simulation still runs and the tutor can explain the problem.

analyses.description: Override the circuit's analyses. `None` uses `circuit.analyses`, or `.op` if that is empty.

text.description: Deterministic: parts in natural refdes order.

node_map.description: IR net id -> SPICE node name ("N_VOUT" -> "n_vout", "GND" -> "0").

includes.description: Registry model files the simulator must load, relative to the registry root.

meas.description:
Spec checks as primitive `.meas` statements, in replay order (later cards may use earlier
results).

checks.description:
The spec checks of every template block, and which `meas` results each combines
([`crate::template::evaluate_checks`]).

pin_currents.description:
Current into each connected pin (`"R1.1"`), as a sum of saved vectors, for the overlays
and current probes. OP and transient plots only: device currents do not exist in AC.
Pins inside subcircuit models (op-amps, regulators) are absent; a net with one such pin
gets its current by KCL.

analyses.description: The analyses in the deck, in order (resolved from `CompileOpts`).

meas.description: `.meas` result names, in the order the kind combines them. Empty when `missing` is set.

missing.description: Why the check could not be compiled into this netlist ("needs an AC analysis").

SpecCheckDef.description: A check as compiled into one netlist: which `.meas` results it combines.

oneOf.description: −3 dB frequency below the pass-band gain (AC).

Q of a 2nd-order low/high-pass: |H(f0)| / pass-band gain, f0 at the ∓90° phase point (AC).
Assumes the input port is driven with flat phase (a source or a buffer).
|V(out)| / |V(in)| at `at_hz` (AC).
Band-pass centre, √(f_lo·f_hi) of the −3 dB points around the peak (AC).
Band-pass Q, centre / (f_hi − f_lo) (AC).

Frequency of a periodic output: two periods between rising crossings of mid-level, in the
second half of the transient (tran).
Share of a period the output is high, from its average over two periods (tran).
Half the peak-to-peak output (tran).
Average output over the transient: the DC level (ngspice `.meas` has no OP mode).
Input level at the 2nd rising/falling output edge: a comparator threshold (tran).

CheckKind.description:
LLD §7 spec checks. Each is a few primitive ngspice `.meas` results combined by
[`evaluate_checks`] (ngspice cannot measure an expression such as `vdb(out)-vdb(in)`).

symbols.description:
Schematic symbols by id (`symbols/<id>.svg`): geometry only; the drawings ship in the
bundle's sprite sheet.

templates.description: Block templates by id (`templates/<id>.yaml`), each checked against the parts at load.

units.description: Units of a multi-unit IC (e.g. `[A, B]` for a dual op-amp). Empty for single-unit parts.

params.description: Every param must declare a default, so instances always carry a full param set.

dc_param.description: For voltage sources: the param holding V(P) − V(N) at DC (used by ERC007).

symbol.description: Schematic symbol, `symbols/<id>.svg`; its pin anchors are matched by pin name.

oneOf.description: Not connected internally; exempt from ERC001.

min.description: In SI units. YAML sources may write a prefixed number such as `1p` or `100meg`.

SpiceDef.description:
SPICE emission template. `line` is for single-unit parts; `unit_line` is emitted once per
used unit of a multi-unit part. Placeholders: `{refdes}`, `{unit}`, pin names, param names.
In `unit_line`, a unit pin is named without its `_<unit>` suffix (`{OUT}` → `OUT_A`).

pins.description: Pin anchors by pin name (base name for the unit pins of a multi-unit part).

side.description: The edge the anchor sits on; wires leave the symbol in this direction.

targets.description: What the user asks for, in order (the insert form shows them in this order).

ports.description: The block's interface: port name -> direction.

rails.description: The supply each power port expects: default rail and the range the design works over.

parts.description: Local refdes (R1, C1, U1, ...) -> registry part. Renumbered on instantiation.

nets.description: Port or internal net name -> pins (`R1.2`, `U1.OUT_A`). Every port has one.

verify.description: The test bench CI simulates the template in (LLD §12 step 2).

min.description: In SI units; YAML may write `10`, `50k` or `1meg`.

default.description: As the user would type it.

scale.description: How verification spreads its points (frequencies and gains are `log`).

net.description: The rail this port binds to by default (created if missing).

min.description: The supply range the design is verified over; absent means exactly `volts`.

symbol.description: A few characters for badges on the drawing: `fc`, `Q`, `Vth+`.

pass.description: Which side of a corner is the pass band (corner and Q checks).

edge.description: Output edge whose input level is the threshold (threshold checks).

at_hz.description: Frequency a gain is measured at; default 1 kHz.

tran.description:
The transient a time-domain check needs. Regenerative circuits (a Schmitt trigger) switch
late in simulation unless the steps are near the op-amp's own speed: with coarse steps the
integrator follows the unstable balance point until it hits a rail.

CheckDef.description:
One spec check: what to measure (a closed set of kinds, so a template can never inject SPICE)
on which ports. Its target is the block's `spec[name]`.

drive.description: A sine source from each listed port to ground.

load.description: A resistor from each listed port to ground, in ohms.

WireEnd.description:
Where a wire ends: a pin, an existing net (a wire or a power/ground flag of it), or a supply
rail, which is created with its kind if it does not exist yet (the editor's GND and rail tools).

targets.description: Target values as typed ("1k", "0.707"); a missing target takes the template default.

ports.description:
How each port is wired; a missing port takes its default (signals: a new net; power: the
template's rail; ground: GND).

id.description: Block id; default the lowest free `bN`.

InsertBlock.description: Insert a block from a template (the editor's "insert block", the generator's fallback).

oneOf.description: An existing net (for a power port: an existing rail, whose voltage the solver uses).
A new net named after the block and port (`B2_IN`).
A supply rail at `volts`, created if it does not exist.

values.description: Solved part values by the template's local refdes.

spec.description: The block's spec: every check's target and tolerance.

spec_display.description: Each spec target formatted for reading (`1kHz`, `0.707`, `2.5V`).

Preview.description: What inserting would produce, before anything is applied: the insert form shows it.

ops.description: Apply as one batch (author `template`): one undo step.

refdes.description: Local refdes -> refdes in the circuit.

CheckResult.description:
One check's outcome (LLD §7: `{name, target, measured, tol_pct, pass}`), with the numbers
already formatted by the core so no client formats units itself.

VerifyPoint.description: One verification point: target values as text (what a user would type) and rail volts.
